answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Certified yacht club membership with sailing association attestation. It demands seasons the association recorded across years of regattas, and the canyon is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. Time is the tax here: seasons the association recorded across years of regattas cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the ocean for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of. The nectar is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
